steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Bohemian Rhapsody has six distinct sections: intro-ballad-guitar solo-opera-rock-outro — each with different musical elements creating dramatic contrast.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Queen's vocal harmonies (often multi-tracked) create rich, layered textures — a signature sound built through studio overdubbing and arrangement.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Brian May's guitar tone uses a homemade guitar (the Red Special) with a coin as a plectrum and heavy amplification, creating a unique orchestral quality.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Love of My Life is a piano ballad with classical influences: arpeggiated accompaniment, chromatic harmony, and Mercury's expressive legato vocal line.

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Always use PRECISE musical vocabulary — not vague descriptions like it sounds nice Reference SPECIFIC musical elements when analysing any piece For listening questions: identify elements FIRST, then explain their effect For study pieces: know the context, structure and key features in detail For performing: focus on accuracy, expression and interpretation For composing: show development of ideas, not just repetition
